project_type: Next.js 14 App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Prisma ORM
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build to confirm no TypeScript/build errors. Run pnpm test to check tests pass.
setup_instructions: pnpm install to install deps. prisma generate for DB client.
environment_constraints: No DB connection available for runtime testing. Build validation only.
contribution_requirements: Commit all changes on feat/copy-trading-dashboard branch. Do NOT push.
key_patterns: shadcn/ui Card components, lucide-react icons, Recharts for charts, cn() utility for class merging, 'use client' directive for client components, formatCurrency/formatDate from @/lib/utils
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js app router pages and API routes; src/components/ - React components organized by domain (dashboard, metrics, ui); src/lib/ - utilities, auth, prisma client, validations
